tei:div.tei:p: (89)zhi bsang 'don 'grigs ni/ thog mar/ na mo gtso ma'i=

ltung bshags/ thub bstod/ spros bral/ bsam lhun/ mtsho dbus/ mkha' dbyings= skyabs gnas sogs/ hrīḥsngon= spos phyung*/ sems can thams cad bla ma la= rgyal brngan skyabs sems 2 zhi ba/ hūm̐/ pad sdong= la'o/ rngan/ swa bhā ba= sogs/ wast+ra āḥhūm̐ 'ur sum brdung*/ zhi ba'i dug phyung*/ 'ur sum brdung*/ hūm̐/ stong gsum/ rngan/ 'dab drug lte ba= kun 'grub shog cha snyom gsum/ rakṣa hūṃ/ sngon tshe o rgyan= lha srin sde brgyad rnams kyi bkra shis shog / btsan/ ra dge/ zhi ba'i sa slong*/ gnas yid du= zer bar bsam/ rang nyid skad cig gis= hūṃ phaṭaḥ me lha drang srong du= ye swa hā/ mdun gyi maṇḍal la= bstim/ 'ur sum brdung*/ oṃ/ dad pa= 'dod gsol/ 'ur sum brdung*/ dung dkar rgya/ oṃ/ ye shais = swa hāḥ 'ur bdun brdung*/ dung dkar rgya/ oṃ/ tshangs pa= 'tshalaḥ bdun brdung 1 agne ra tsa= mdzodaḥ me lha khyod nyid= mdzod cig 'ur gsum brdung dung dkar rgya/ me lha'i lto ba= gyur/ sil snyan/ 'ur sum brdung*/ dung dkar rgya/ hūm̐/ dus la= āḥhūṃḥ 'dod gsol mchod rol/ oṃ/ ye shes= swa hā/ mchod rol bdun brdung*/ oṃ/ bde gshegs= bstodaḥ bdun brdung 1 oṃ bla ma du gsol/ 'ur sum brdung*/ srid zhi'i mgron/ rnga gong ltar/ yon tan mgron snying rje'i mgron bgegs rigs lan chags mgron/ mi lha me yi/ rol mo yin/ phyag 'tshal/ bdun rdung 3 yig brgya mthar/ 'ur sum brdung*/ oṃ/ ston mchog= 90) si swa hāḥ smra bsam brjod med= zab mdo tshar nas tshogs grol/ rngan/ dpag med= ye hūm̐ḥ dungadakar3 'ur sum brdung*/ 'dzam bu gling gi= 'ur sum brdung*/ dung rgya dkar/ kyai/ bsang gi= phyir/ bdun brdung re/ skyabs mchog= lha rgyal lo/ 'ur sum brdung*/ dung dkar rgya/ tshe ring gtor 'bul/ gses mkhar/ bdud rtsi sprin phung*/ 'ur sum brdung*/ dung dkar rgya/ mthar 'ur sum brdung*/ ri bo bsang mchod/ mnol bsang mthar/ 'ur sum brdung dung*/

dkar rgya/ zhi chung*/ 'ur sum brdung*/ dung dkar rgya/ ma ning bsang rab/ 'ur sum brdung dung dkar rgya/ bswo/ rno rje dgra bla rgyas bsdus/ mchod sbyin= 'ur sum brdung dung dkar rgya/ dgra bla'i/ ye dharma= ma mo'i a ka ro/ 'ur sum brdung dung dkar rgya/ bhyo/ kun tu bzang po= rnga gong ltar/ bhyo/ ri rab = na mo dhāe wi= rnga gong ltar/ tam̐ḥ ye shes= bsdu na/ hūm̐/ rab 'jigs = 'khor lo sdom= rnga gong ltar/ hūm̐/ sum ldan/ rta bsang yod rigs/ na mo arya= nor lha bsang*/ mthar rnga gong ltar/ spyi bor nyi zla/ dzaḥ rol brdung*/ sil snyan 'ur gsum brdung*/ dkar rgya rkang*/ kyai/ nyi ma= dam chen mchod rol re re/ nam mkha' 'ja' 'od= dam chen mchod rol/ tshogs grol/ sbub chal/ 'ur sum brdung*/ lam lha rnams/ dan bsdud/ rkang rnga gong ltar/ thugs rje chen po rlung rta rnams/ thang lha/ spom ra/ ge sar/ dgra brub/ rkang*/ rnga gong ltar/ mthar 'ur sum brdung*/ gsol lo mchod do/ 'khrugs bcos/ gdangs chen/ yar tshogs nas/ dung dkar rkang dung spel ma3 sil snyan/ 'ur sum brdung*/ hūm̐/ mchod yon= dkar rgya dung*/ mchod rol/ bdun 'thing re re/ bya dkar mthar/ 'bras kyi lha g.yag= gzhi bdag yongs rdzogs/ dgongs 'dus yul lha/ kye/ ma g.yel= mdzod (91) mchod rol bdun thing*/ rngan/ hūm̐/ gzhan yang*/ rgyal bar shog mchod rol bdun thing*/ slar rol bsu/ dkar rgya rkang 3 rgya sil snyan/ 'ur mgon po sum brdung*/ dgra che chung rnams tshar grangs bsags nas/ tshogs grol/ yar tshogs nas bsang bkyag la/ mgon po 'khor bcas/ rol bsu dkar/ rgya/ rkang 3 rgya sil snyan/ 'ur sum brdung*/ ho/ ye shes= mtshams su mchod rol re/ kyai/ gsol lo= mchod rol gong ltar/ gang zhig= rnga brdung*/ 'ur sum brdung*/ bhrūm̐ yig= sbub chal yin/ mthar rnga brdung bcas/ bsang chen che dus bzhag stabs yin/ kyai/ bdag sogs= bkra shis shog bkra shis sa gzhi brtan pa'i zhing sa la/ dngos grub lo thog 'bras bu mchog tu smin// skye 'gro sems can bde la 'god pa yi/

yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde ba'i bkra shis shog rgyal mtshan rtse mo= zhi khro yi dam= ma mo mkha' 'gro= sngon tshe o rgyan= nor gyi dbang phyug= zab cing rgya che= bsod rnams ri bo= bgegs rigs stong phrag= lo brgya 'tsho zhing= ston pa 'jig rten= bstan pa'i dpal gyur= de ltar bsang mchod phul ba'i= yul lha gzhi bdag= skyabs gnas bslu med= 'jig rten bde zhing= lha yang dus su= sman rnams mthu dang= phyogs dus rgyal ba= 'di nas nub kyi= 'phags mchog= sogs (92)kyis sbrel/ ces pa 'di'ang padma ma ṇis so// (93)
